newsitem.title: HONG KONG: SEG details 1996 dividend plan.
newsitem.headline: SEG details 1996 dividend plan.

text.p: Television tube maker Shenzhen SEG Co Ltd on Friday said it would make a three-for-10 bonus issue to shareholders based on 1996 profits.

The company has set the bonus issue registration deadline for domestic currency A shares and foreign currency B shares on July 7 and the shares will go ex-dividend on July 8, it said in a statement in the Shenzhen-based Securities Times.
Bonus A shares will be listed on July 10 and bonus B shares on July 11, the statement said.
SEG's net profits soared to 127.22 million yuan in 1996 from 100.05 million yuan in 1995 based on international accounting standards.

Last month, the company announced its shareholders had agreed to issue an additional 50 million B shares but the plan required the final approval of the China Securities Regulatory Commission, China's top securities watchdog.
The firm said it would price the new shares nearer to the offer date based on market conditions and use the proceeds to fund business expansion.
The company also said it planned to launch the issue after distributing the dividend.
